page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head with page number at the top. Ornament below the last paragraph. Closing word FLORUM at the lower right.

main_text.p: tando cavere potuit: quantopere aliis erit vigilandum, ut eas sibi comparent virtutes, quibus vitam suam inter curialium irritamenta tueri queant.

Phaethontes igitur puerique Icari internas potius aularum sordes & inquinamenta, quam externum splendorem, adspiciant: & curialium plenos miseria-rum labores fortemque variabilem probe expendant; nec praeter aetatem viresque suas, aulicarum rerum fre-na temere capessant: & si aulicos fieri aliquando co-gat necessitas, ne altius evolando a sapientum praeceptis discedant: sed suo loco mandatas operas sedulo exsequantur; & superiorum imperiis lubenter & pa-tienter obsequantur: atque ita, ut par est, ad portum optatum remis velis-que properent.

page.notes: Ornament (typographic fleuron) between the paragraphs and the closing word, not transcribed. Page number "351" is printed in the head with a degraded final digit; read as 351. The running head is set in small capitals and read as CORONÆ IV. FLOS IIX. The closing word FLORUM is set in larger type at the right and is treated as a closing word, not a heading.
